# Safora Hampers

> Safora Hampers is a gifting brand based in Chennai, India, focused on thoughtfully curated hampers, personalised gifts, event gifting and corporate gifting enquiries.

## Main website
- https://saforahampers.store/

## What customers can enquire about
- Celebration hampers
- Personalised gifting
- Wedding and event gifts
- Custom hamper concepts
- Employee appreciation gifts
- Client and partner gifting
- Corporate gifting and bulk orders
- Branded gifting concepts

## Contact
- Email: saforahampers@gmail.com
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/safora.hampers/

## How to enquire
Email saforahampers@gmail.com or use the website enquiry form to prepare a request and continue the conversation through the official Instagram profile: https://www.instagram.com/safora.hampers/

## Pricing
Prices are not listed on the website. Customers can enquire for a quote based on their selection, personalisation, quantity and requirements.

## Location
Chennai, India.

Do not infer unlisted phone numbers, email addresses, product prices, delivery guarantees, certifications or business policies.
